description: This file defines the AppendStream class which implements the StreamInterface to allow reading from multiple streams sequentially as a single combined stream. The class provides methods for appending streams, reading content, seeking, and managing stream resources.

classes.name: AppendStream
classes.description: A read-only stream decorator that allows concatenating multiple streams for sequential reading, supporting rewind, seek, and status queries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes AppendStream with an optional list of streams to append.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the entire content of the combined streams as a string, rewinding before reading.

methods.name: addStream
methods.description: Appends a new stream (must be readable) to the sequence.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the contents of the combined streams as a string.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes all attached streams and resets internal state.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches all streams and resets internal state; returns null.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the combined stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of all streams if possible; returns null otherwise.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of all appended streams has been reached.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Resets the internal position to the starting point.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Attempts to reposition the read pointer to a specific offset; only supports SEEK_SET.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data sequentially from the current position across appended streams.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns true, as this stream is read-only.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns false, as this stream does not support writing.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns whether all constituent streams are seekable.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception; writing is not supported.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns metadata about the stream; null if key is specified.
